card.name: Inside fatty acid and vitamin names
card.fires_on: Partway through nutrient names such as fatty acid desaturase, essential fatty acid, and vitamin K, on the word just before the name is complete. Also on 'be' in 'cannot be synthesized'.

modes.label: Fatty acid terms
modes.description: Fires on 'des' or 'acid' inside fatty acid enzyme or deficiency names.

modes.label: Vitamin K
modes.description: Fires on the letter K after 'vitamin' in anticoagulant interaction text.
modes.example: Due to potential inhibition of vitamin<< K>> activity by methimazole

modes.label: Synthesis wording
modes.description: Fires on 'be' just before 'synthesized' when talking about essential nutrients.
modes.example: These "essential" amino acids cannot<< be>> synthesized from other precursors.

card.writes: It nudges the output toward synthesis and biochemistry terms, such as 'ynthesis' and 'Oxygen'.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of nutrient names like fatty acid and vitamin K, in text about making or lacking nutrients.
